goal: Generate technically correct proportional SVG chimney diagrams. All dimensions, joints, diameters, overlaps and building geometry must affect the actual SVG geometry, not only labels.

global_rules.unknown_value_policy: Show the value as requiring measurement or manager review; never replace it with invented geometry or an invented SKU.

finished_floor_datum.rule: All absolute vertical measurements use the same finished-floor datum. A laser measurement made from a veranda or another level must be corrected to this datum before use.

ridge_height.definition: Absolute vertical distance from finished floor level to the INNER LOWER EDGE of the roof ridge.
ridge_height.measurement_method: Laser distance meter from the same finished-floor datum to the visible inner ridge vault/edge.
ridge_height.svg_rule: The dimension arrow starts exactly at finished floor level and ends exactly at the inner lower edge of the ridge.
forbidden: silently add room height to an already absolute ridge height
use a laser origin with a different floor elevation without correction

ridge_horizontal_distance.definition: Horizontal plan distance from the vertical chimney axis to the ridge axis.
ridge_horizontal_distance.svg_rule: The value drives both local roof geometry and ridge-clearance calculation; it is never measured along the roof slope.

roof_build_up.rule: Roof construction thickness must be represented geometrically.
roof_build_up.measurement_axis: vertical chimney axis at the planned passage
roof_build_up.description: Show both inner roof surface and outer roof surface. Roof thickness affects the actual length of the chimney section passing through the roof.

floor_and_attic_geometry.floor_zone_formula: floor_zone = [room_height_mm, room_height_mm + floor_thickness_mm] for the first level, accumulated for later levels
floor_and_attic_geometry.consistency_rule: If a separately measured attic height conflicts with ridge/distance/angle geometry, report the conflict. Do not silently move the ridge or roof passage.

termination_height_rules.grate_definition_plain_language: The grate is the metal grid inside the firebox on which the firewood lies; ash falls through it into the ash pan.
termination_height_rules.missing_grate_rule: If the appliance has no identifiable grate, require the appliance passport or manufacturer datum. Never substitute stove height or flue-connection height.

pitched_roof.svg_rule: Draw the 10 degree reference line from the ridge and keep the chimney mouth on or above it.

explanation_contract.plain_language_example: By roof: 3900 mm. By 5 m from grate: 5150 mm. The 5 m condition controls the result.

termination_height_rules.discrete_layout_rule: Select the shortest valid effective pipe layout whose mouth is not below the calculated minimum.
termination_height_rules.tall_exposed_stack_rule: Do not shorten a compliant route merely because it looks tall. Flag the exposed section for engineering support review without inventing bracing SKUs or limits.

rotary_damper.rule: Rotary damper belongs to the single-wall section and must have the same pipe diameter as the single-wall start pipe.
rotary_damper.length_rule: The 50 mm inserted port is already included in the 130 mm effective installed length; never add it again.

sandwich_pipe.rule: D_SANDWICH must always be visually larger than D_SINGLE.

forbidden: draw single-wall pipe equal in outside width to sandwich pipe
draw damper wider than single-wall pipe
draw sandwich pipe narrower than single-wall pipe

connection_rules.rule: EVERY connection where one chimney component enters/connects to another must show a 50 mm insertion/connection zone.
connection_rules.effective_height_formula: Pipe/support component: effective_height_mm = nominal_height_mm - 50. Rotary damper exception: effective_height_mm = 130 because the inserted port is already accounted for.
connection_rules.svg_geometry_rule: Do not place components end-to-end using full nominal heights. The 50 mm connection zone is geometrically shared/overlapped and therefore must not add to total chimney height.
connection_rules.visual_joint_rule: Every joint must be visibly readable in the SVG as a connection zone approximately 50 mm high at the diagram scale.
connection_rules.critical: Total assembled chimney height must be calculated from EFFECTIVE heights, not the sum of nominal catalogue heights.

orientation.narrow_side: connects to single-wall / damper section below
orientation.wide_side: connects to sandwich pipe section above

support_cap_transition.svg_rule: The transition must visibly expand from the smaller single-wall diameter below to the larger sandwich diameter above.
forbidden: cylinder with equal upper and lower diameter
narrow side connected to sandwich pipe
wide side connected to single-wall pipe

floor_clamp.rule: The floor/ceiling clamp must be drawn DIRECTLY OVER the chimney pipe, not behind it and not interrupted by the pipe.
floor_clamp.mounting: Mounting ears extend sideways and visually connect to the floor joists.
forbidden: clamp split into two unrelated pieces
floating clamp not connected to joists

finish_flanges.opening_relation: Each flat flange outer edge must extend beyond the passage opening on both sides so the flange visibly covers the complete opening perimeter.
finish_flanges.dimension_policy: Do not state an exact overhang until the opening and selected flange SKU dimensions are known.

decorative_skirts.svg_rule: Draw each skirt as a separate foreground collar without replacing or hiding the flange. Its wide base edge must be flush with the exposed outer face of its flange: upper skirt on the upper flange face, lower skirt on the lower flange face, with no gap and no overlap into the flange thickness.

wool_quantity.typical_manager_orientation_only: 3-6 kits; this is not an automatic engineering quantity
wool_quantity.forbidden: Do not calculate wool quantity from an assumed package volume and do not hard-code an automatic quantity.

decorative_skirts.svg_rule: Draw a separate foreground collar over the flange on each face of every straight wall passage.

catalog_identity.selection_rule: Choose the SKU whose confirmed diameter_min_mm <= D_SANDWICH <= diameter_max_mm and whose permitted roof angle includes the measured angle.
catalog_identity.substitution_rule: Master Flash is a separate flexible sealing product and must never be returned, labelled or drawn as the UPK BOM line.

master_flash.position: separate flexible element mounted on the chimney pipe

upk.position: separate rigid metal roof-passage element after Master Flash in the confirmed assembly order

default_bom_components.interaction_rule: For both pitched and flat roofs, both lines start in BOM. The user can remove and restore either line independently without changing pipe layout, route geometry or the other BOM line.

outside_element.name: УПК по углу кровли
outside_element.position: outside on the upper roof surface
outside_element.layering: foreground above the chimney pipe at the passage
outside_element.shape: rigid metal base plate with a rigid angled metal neck/cone matching the selected UPK family
outside_element.rule: The UPK visually overlaps the pipe at the joint while preserving the straight constant pipe diameter above and below it. Do not draw an EPDM/silicone stepped cone.

inside_element.name: Внутренний фланец
inside_element.position: inside on the lower roof surface
inside_element.pitched_roof_shape: flat flange plate following the roof angle with an angled pipe opening
inside_element.opening_relation: The flange outer edge must extend beyond both sides of the rafter passage opening so the full opening perimeter is covered.

rafter_passage.side_fill: Render the manually selected wool as two distinct hatched zones, one on each side of the sandwich pipe inside the rafter opening.
rafter_passage.floor_clamp_reuse: Use the same rectangular Хомут в перекрытие family and the same pipe-sized clamp body as in the floor passage.
rafter_passage.clamp_orientation: The clamp body remains level and perpendicular to the vertical pipe exactly as in the floor passage; never rotate the clamp body to the roof angle.
rafter_passage.ear_mounting: Only the side mounting ears extend to and fasten to the rafters on both sides.
rafter_passage.layering: Clamp body and ears are drawn in the foreground over the pipe, wool and rafter opening.
forbidden: rotate the whole clamp to the roof angle
hide the clamp behind the pipe
show wool on only one side
leave mounting ears floating without rafter attachment

decorative_skirt.flat_roof: optional only when explicitly selected by the route/BOM
decorative_skirt.rule: Never merge a decorative skirt, the inner flange and the external UPK into one symbol.

roof_passage.pipe_opening_rule: At the exact location where the sandwich pipe exits through the roof flashing, the opening/neck width must equal the OUTER DIAMETER of the sandwich pipe.
roof_passage.geometry: The pipe remains straight and constant in diameter through the roof passage.
forbidden: invented adapter between flashing and pipe
roof_passage.reference_intent: Match the corrected reference drawing: the roof flashing terminates directly against the straight vertical pipe without changing the pipe silhouette.

termination_component.rule: Draw the selected real terminal/deflector family as a readable component on the pipe axis.
forbidden: terminal geometry that changes the calculated mouth datum

pipe_geometry.vertical_axis: All straight vertical chimney elements share one centerline unless the scenario explicitly contains offsets.
pipe_geometry.rule: Never change pipe width merely to make the illustration look attractive.

proportional_layout.rule: All vertical positions must be calculated from actual input dimensions.
proportional_layout.scale_rule: Choose one millimetres-to-pixels coefficient for the entire scene and use it for rooms, floors, attic, roof build-up, pipes, passage zones, joints and termination height.
proportional_layout.rebuild_rule: When any measurement changes, recompute coordinates and rebuild the SVG geometry; changing labels alone is forbidden.
must_account_for: 50 mm insertion overlap at every joint

rendering_order: upper and lower floor finish flanges OVER the passage opening
interior angled roof flange as a separate element
external UPK roof flashing IN FOREGROUND over pipe
validation_before_output: Check that floor-to-ridge dimension ends at the INNER LOWER EDGE of ridge.
Check that ridge height is an absolute finished-floor measurement, not attic height or roof rise.
Check roof inner surface at chimney = ridge height - horizontal ridge distance * tan(roof angle).
Check roof outer surface at chimney = roof inner surface + measured roof build-up along the chimney axis.
Check that the mouth height satisfies the applicable ridge-distance branch and the minimum height from the grate.
Check that the result separately explains roof requirement, five-metre requirement, controlling requirement, minimum height and actual discrete height.
Check D_SINGLE < D_SANDWICH.
Check upper and lower floor flanges extend beyond both edges of every floor passage opening in the detail and main route SVG.
Check the angled interior roof flange extends beyond both edges of the rafter passage opening in the detail and main route SVG.
Check rotary damper diameter equals D_SINGLE.
Check every socketed joint consumes 50 mm of nominal component length.
Check effective component height = nominal height - 50 mm.
Check support cap is a correctly oriented trapezoid: narrow below, wide above.
Check floor clamp is rendered over the pipe and attached to joists.
Check passage glass, wool kits and floor clamp remain separate BOM lines; wool quantity is manual.
Check roof passage wool is visibly hatched on both sides of the pipe inside the rafter opening.
Check the roof-passage clamp body is level like the floor clamp, is not rotated with the roof, and both ears attach to rafters.
Check pitched roof has a separate inner angled flange and no decorative skirt.
Check external UPK is rendered in the foreground over the pipe.
Check roof flashing opening is exactly D_SANDWICH.
Check there are no decorative collars, rolled edges or invented diameter changes.
Check total chimney height from SVG coordinates matches calculated effective assembled height.

expected_termination_mm.actual: the shortest valid effective SKU layout at or above 5150

failure_policy.rule: If any validation rule fails, DO NOT output the SVG. Correct the geometry first and validate again.
